acceptanceCriteria: Reconcile DOGFOOD_INTENTS_FILE input wording with OCM-V0-009 and decisions 0055/0170: same-change proposed intent is permitted as bootstrap scope, its matching CEM hunk stays explicitly unknown and never historical evidence.
Retain the exact-base/target/map validation condition and fail-closed behavior; preserve the explicit no-intent path for changes without an applicable requirements scope.
Read back the corrected instructions against accepted decisions; do not change runtime policy or weaken CEM unknown admission.
body:
Confirmed documentation discrepancy while closing #393. At source HEAD28f8b3d5ab8b23af554963d126c10fea64266567 (base25971bda1ca1664d8a546d751cb2bb9bbd454daf), docs/DOGFOOD.md:52 says each intent must exist at BASE and a spec created in this change cannot be intent. OCM-V0-009 (docs/specs/ocm-v0-dogfood.md:123-132), accepted decision0055 and decision0170 expressly permit same-change proposed intent absent at base, with matching CEM hunks unknown and independently validated OCM before allowance. internal/localcompletion/finish.go:162-170 implements the bootstrap count. Expected: instructions describe the accepted bootstrap path without implying historical CEM evidence. Actual: direct contradiction may cause an operator to remove valid intent or alter a frozen enrollment. Observation Core163 rc1 / Tasks202 developer, 2026-09-30; documentation-only finding, no failed runtime qualification claimed. Deduplicated native agent-memory searches bootstrap/same-change/DOGFOOD_INTENTS_FILE; V1-0259 concerns a different missing requirements-form capability. Acceptance evidence: exact source citations and manual readback; narrow reversible prose repair.

2026-10-02 concrete recurrence during PR473/V1-0662 repair: root prepared an index-snapshot-only frozen original-base plan because that intent exists at BASE cdd2e31fffd732419eb9ade531ccf289259f3243; inherited immutable-delta intent is present at enrollmentHEAD abb23961 but absentBASE. Enrollmentkey3a7dcfdc1be4cdbad5162361c53895929fa28c98caf5df5c9aa43f130e32380b plan4ff34c0abf3058f20b2fad5e5f50b8ea809fe6730f359dd39ff943ee5aed67f0 retained before4ordinaryCEMinverses. Actual fixture witness baseline4detachedchildlaunches/fixed0/eachsiteoverlay1and2, allbehaviorassertionsPASS. Whole original-range CEM has legitimate same-change intent unknown; finish.go122-177 regenerates intentmanifest solely from frozenPlan.Intents and derives zero bootstrap allowance here. Supplementary delta OCM cannot change frozen scope. Required finish remains NOT_PRODUCED for predicted cem-bindings-required; no runtime refusal execution, cancel/re-enroll, replacementledger, fakeauthoritycitation, publication or completion claimed. Plan admission mistake is root-owned; the accepted bootstrap contract/runtime is not defective. Evidence prepare473-plan.md, fixture473/begin.json and builder future boundmanifest under /private/tmp/corvint-codex-batch.S53nDh. Expected pre-enrollment guidance/preflight preserves all owning same-change bootstrap intents in a combined diff, never removes them because absentBASE. ExistingV1-0561 is the governing documentation discrepancy; this updates concretefriction instead of a duplicate ticket. Core163/Tasks202 unchanged, no runtime qualification claim.
title: Dogfood daily-path intent instructions contradict accepted bootstrap scope
